description: This file defines the SmsHandler class responsible for managing SMS-related operations such as sending and searching SMS messages. It interacts with an SmsManager instance and integrates with GatewaySession for handling the results.

classes.name: SmsHandler
classes.description: A class that handles SMS sending and searching operations, wrapping calls to SmsManager and generating GatewaySession invoke results.

methods.name: handleSmsSend
methods.description: Handles the SMS send request, invoking the sms.send method, and returning the result wrapped in a GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: handleSmsSearch
methods.description: Handles the SMS search request, invoking the sms.search method, and returning a GatewaySession.InvokeResult accordingly.

methods.name: errorResult
methods.description: Generates an error GatewaySession.InvokeResult based on an error message or code.
